Does Brad Pitt die in Thelma & Louise?

He plays J.D., a supporting role.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. Steals the cash and walks; the women drive off the cliff.

Drifter J.D. charms Thelma into a motel-room night and then robs the women of Louise's $6,700 life savings, which triggers Thelma's turn to armed robbery. He's later picked up and questioned by the police, who use him to help track the women. J.D. is alive and in custody when Thelma and Louise fly the T-bird into the canyon.

Pitt's breakout role.
